fn count_elements_mod_0(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else if ((n % 3) == 2) then (1 + count_elements_mod_0((n - 1))) else count_elements_mod_0((n - 1))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (count_elements_mod_0(0) == 0)
  example (count_elements_mod_0(2) == 1)
{
  if (n == 0) then 0 else if ((n % 3) == 2) then (1 + count_elements_mod_0((n - 1))) else count_elements_mod_0((n - 1))
}

  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (count_elements_mod_1(0) == 0)
  example (count_elements_mod_1(1) == 1)
{

fn combination(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (k >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if ((k > n) or (k < 0)) then 0 else if ((k == 0) or (k == n)) then 1 else if (k == 1) then n else if (k == 2) then ((n * (n - 1)) / 2) else if (k == 3) then (((n * (n - 1)) * (n - 2)) / 6) else 0))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (k > n)) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((not ((k == 0) or (k == n))) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((not (k == 1)) or (result == n))
  ensures ((not ((k == 2) and (n >= 2))) or (result == ((n * (n - 1)) / 2)))
  ensures ((not ((k == 3) and (n >= 3))) or (result == (((n * (n - 1)) * (n - 2)) / 6)))
  effects pure
  example (combination(0, 0) == 1)
  example (combination(0, 1) == 0)
{

}
